author: Dsabitri Adhikari
title: Worst Customer Service
review_text: Been using the app for 7 years but when I had to change phone number, the CS depart is totally unresponsive. It’s been 1 month since I called & mailed them but the issue is not addressed. No response at all. So started using alternatives. 👎
